NEW camera (layout_not_style_echo — do NOT copy style-pad lawn tea-table trio, dog, parasol, or left-right table staging): eye-level three-quarter BUMPER bust from mid-chest up, King and Butler standing shoulder-to-shoulder filling the lower ~65% of frame as the hero read. Left: jolly stout King Robert — white fluffy beard/mustache, thick white brows, large blue irises with catchlights, gold crown with red diamond gem, blue-and-yellow striped royal tunic with gold trim, festive gold ribbon corsage on chest. Right: slim butler — salt-and-pepper hair, grey handlebar mustache, warm medium skin, red frock coat, grey vest, white cravat and gloves; he holds a small festive gold sparkler wand (NOT a yellow parasol) near the king. Their faces are large, emotional, celebrating: king open joyful smile, butler proud gentle smile. Behind them a soft shallow-DOF fairy-tale castle with cream walls and purple roofs occupies only the upper third as atmospheric backdrop under bright warm sunny cyan sky with soft stylized clouds; slight offset so crowns keep clean sky silhouette. Soft-plastic Royal Match commercial casual CGI: palette gold #F5C542, castle purple #7B5CDB, coat red #E23B3B, sky cyan #3DB8E8, cream stone, lime hedge hints only as soft blur; soft upper-right daylight, rounded toy-like forms, clean small highlights not oily. Element budget: two characters + shallow castle + sky + tiny festive sparkles only. rounds.next_fix: 重构时略缩小或上移双人并给右侧肩臂增加留白，明确顶部星与魔杖星的主次，建议弱化或移除顶部悬浮星；重新校正握杖手指、掌心包裹与杆件穿行关系，并以更克制的高光和不同粗糙度拉开金属、织物、毛发及皮肤材质。

Left: jolly stout King Robert — white fluffy beard/mustache, thick white brows, large blue irises with catchlights, gold crown with red diamond gem, blue-and-yellow striped royal tunic with gold trim, festive gold ribbon corsage on chest. Right: slim butler — salt-and-pepper hair, grey handlebar mustache, warm medium skin, red frock coat, grey vest, white cravat and gloves; he holds a small festive gold sparkler wand (NOT a yellow parasol) near the king. Behind them a soft shallow-DOF fairy-tale castle with cream walls and purple roofs occupies only the upper third as atmospheric backdrop under bright warm sunny cyan sky with soft stylized clouds; slight offset so crowns keep clean sky silhouette. Hard fail-at-glance: any dog, third character, breakfast table, lawn dining, full-body legs, logo/UI text, or same machine as style pad = fail. Joints continuous; both pupils share direction/height; fingers on sparkler grip readable.
